FN-MRDQWH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 161
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/28/2023
House Bill 161 as introduced would reduce the obligations of the Department of Insurance by
an estimated $5,000 annually due to the reduction in fees related to notice of certain hearings.
